message: 本気
KiraFes wrapped up without a hitch, and up next in two months is the Holy Night Festival.
I haven't even put together a rough draft yet, so I figured I'd borrow some books on Christmas from the library and study up.

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot―san? Hello, it's rare to see you out here―」
Melilot-san raises an index finger to her lips, silencing me with a sharp look.

name: Melilot
message: 「Hehe...」
Whatever meaning lies behind it, Melilot-san places a single stone beside the flowerbed. Several stones are already stacked up there.

name: Melilot
message: 「That makes eight laps. I am currently taking a stroll, walking round and round the library.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Aah, I see! That's great exercise!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「...I dunno about that, man.」
There's a rumor at the academy that the library is Melilot-san's house.
If that were true, Melilot-san would be living in a room bigger than anyone else's in Ryuusei Town, surrounded by more belongings--especially books--than anyone else.
At the same time, the area around the library would be like her own courtyard garden.

name: Melilot
message: 「I jest.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I was seeing off a dorm student who came to borrow some books.」

name: Melilot
message: 「She had been suffering from homesickness for quite some time, shutting herself in her room and reading a great many books as a result, however...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Thanks to the preparations for KiraFes getting underway, it seems she has begun to recover.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Once a student establishes a rhythm in their life and their days become regular, they cease to pine for home...」

name: Synn
message: 「A first-year? Then for half a year ever since enrolling...」

name: Melilot
message: 「She will likely remain a first-year next year as well, though that too has its own charm.」
Melilot-san is a strict person. At the same time, her concern for the students runs deeper than even the teachers'.
That said, she also has a terrifying side: once she gives up on you, she won't give you the time of day until graduation.

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, I have set up a bookshelf dedicated to Christmas near the reading room.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Just to remind you, even if you are the Student Council President, you may only borrow up to three books at a time.」
As always, she gets her work done fast without breaking a sweat.
Suddenly, I try picturing Melilot-san in the middle of setting up that special bookshelf.
Her outfit looks like a maid's uniform, though according to her, it's simply work clothes.
On weekends when the library is open to the public, on rare occasions people who don't know the situation cast uninhibited stares at Melilot-san.
Even so, she doesn't mind it in the slightest.
While wearing these clothes, Melilot-san is a librarian who looks after the students of Ryuusei Academy.
Unbelievably, not a single student has ever seen Melilot-san wearing anything other than this.

name: Melilot
message: 「There are some among the faculty and staff who have, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I jest.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm... I'm going to go borrow a book on Christmas. I hope I can finish reading it before the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Be careful... Time passes by much faster than you imagine.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, excuse me. Just one more lap until three kilometers.」
S-She wasn't joking...
I was able to find the book I was looking for right away.
With the library committee members handling the checkout counter in Melilot-san's place, the library was a little noisier than usual.
